SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, SUM(CASE WHEN summary_feedback = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS summaryGood, SUM(CASE WHEN summary_feedback = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS summaryBad, SUM(CASE WHEN keyword_feedback = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keywordGood, SUM(CASE WHEN keyword_feedback = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keywordBad, SUM(CASE WHEN role_feedback = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS roleGood, SUM(CASE WHEN role_feedback = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS roleBad, SUM(CASE WHEN keypoint_feedback = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keypointGood, SUM(CASE WHEN keypoint_feedback = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keypointBad, SUM(CASE WHEN todo_feedback = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todoGood, SUM(CASE WHEN todo_feedback = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todoBad FROM call_ai_summary WHERE del_flag = 0
AND create_time >= #{begin}
AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY statDate ORDER BY statDate
